name: baoyu-slides
description: Writes editable slide decks as files in your workspace and opens them in a slide editor that runs on your computer. Present, retype, drag, comment for the agent, and export PDF, HTML or PowerPoint. Runs locally on Node.js 20 or later; nothing leaves your computer unless you share it.

interface.longDescription: Writes editable slide decks as files in your workspace and opens them in a slide editor that runs on your computer. Present, retype, drag, comment for the agent, and export PDF, HTML or PowerPoint. Runs locally on Node.js 20 or later; nothing leaves your computer unless you share it.
